Meeting Date:                 4/27/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Scott, Jr. (24)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map Nos. 4-1 and 4-J at 1311-1321
                              and 1312 S Kedzie Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-3,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 4-1 and 4-J
in the area bound by:

      a line 95.9 feet south of and parallel to West 13'" Street; the alley next east of and
      parallel to South Kedzie Avenue; a line 216.9 feet south of and parallel to West 13*"
      Street; South Kedzie Avenue; a line 150 feet south of and parallel to West 13'" Street;
      the alley next west of and parallel to South Kedzie Avenue; a line 125 feet south of and
      parallel to West 13'" Street; and South Kedzie Avenue,

to those of a B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          Mjchael>Scott;Jr.
                                                          Alderman, 24*" Ward




Common Address:
1311-1321 S. Kedzie Avenue
